title: Full Go suite fails locally on two pre-existing tests (already tracked as ticks yjs and pqs)
body: go test ./... (full, not -short) fails at base ddf04119 and at this tick's commit on this host, in TestTheBuiltBinaryExitsTwo (internal/cli, expects to find .tick/runners.toml relative to the test's CWD) and TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo (internal/runstate, armed-repo maintenance fixture on a git that never auto-starts maintenance). Both reproduce at the base commit in a clean worktree and are covered by the open ticks yjs and pqs; recorded here so the orchestrator can match rather than re-propose them.
